opening.argument: The presentation directly promotes a Pionex spot-futures arbitrage bot through reported two-month performance figures. It identifies “the profit after two months is $64” and characterizes the bot as providing “passive income,” while the description expressly says, “Register on Pionex here.” That registration request is materially connected to the advertised figures because Pionex and its bot are the subjects of the claimed results, not merely a channel or audience-engagement request. The video does disclose that “past results are no guarantee for future results,” but that qualification does not remove the central promotional structure: reported earnings are used to present the bot as an income-producing opportunity and direct viewers to the platform. The available record does not independently establish platform performance, viewer outcomes, required deposits, or any completed loss.
